what: Behind the photo, a frame of the same size (background-color face · 0.5px line) sits offset 40px to the lower right. When you hover over the card, the frame face fills with dark ink in .4s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1). It is an event card where a black shadow plate is laid over white paper

options.--fx-shift: Frame offset distance, default 40px (20px on the original mobile)
options.[data-fx-part=pic]: Photo slot to lay the frame on (required) — the image goes inside as its child. Painting a background on the slot itself would cover the frame

from.where: shared.css .ev__pic::before (.c-upcoming__eyecatch::before — event card frame, turns black on hover over .4s)
